text: dsh-crypto-portfolio 是一个自托管 DSH 网页仪表盘：插件接入 Cordis 生命周期后，会启动本机 Python 服务，并以浏览器界面汇总钱包和交易所资产。它读取 Bitcoin、EVM、Solana、Dogecoin、Cardano 与 Hyperliquid 等来源，也支持 Binance、Bybit、Backpack、OKX、Bitget 账户；页面提供资产筛选、趋势历史、手动仓位和计划视图。钱包配置按 profile 保存，刷新结果写入本地 SQLite。适合希望在自己的 DSH 环境中集中查看多链资产的人；需要 Python 运行环境及按需配置的数据源。

dsh-crypto-portfolio is a self-hosted DSH dashboard. Its Cordis plugin starts a local Python service to display Bitcoin, EVM, Solana, Dogecoin, Cardano, Hyperliquid and exchange balances. Users can filter holdings, view history and add manual positions. Python is required.

让 DSH 启动一个本机浏览器页面来查看我的投资组合。
想把还没有自动数据接口的协议仓位手动记到账户总额里。
能不能按不同钱包配置分别保存资产来源和历史？
I want one local dashboard for balances across several blockchains.
Can I review exchange accounts alongside my on-chain wallets?
dsh-crypto-portfolio 的功能「多链资产汇总」：刷新时编排不同链的钱包抓取与定价，并生成统一的代币和余额数据供仪表盘展示。
dsh-crypto-portfolio 的功能「本地历史快照」：资产刷新结果写入 SQLite，按日期保存总额、链和代币明细，供历史趋势查询。
dsh-crypto-portfolio 的功能「手动仓位登记」：用户可为无法自动读取的协议记录钱包、资产符号、数量、估值和日期，数据随后并入统一视图。

A free, 100% self-hosted [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin that unifies your **on-chain and CEX assets** into one self-contained web dashboard.

**Requires** `dsh` `0.1.1-rc.2` (Node `^22.19 || >=24`) · Python 3.9+ · `pip3 install requests pynacl`

```sh
dsh plugin --profile demo add dsh-crypto-portfolio   # npm
dsh --profile demo                                    # dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:8080
```

dsh-crypto-portfolio README · dsh-crypto-portfolio：> **Twin project.** This dashboard is the twin of the [SmartFolio Chrome extension](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/smartfolio/ogiijkjoahbekjnjhnchjefllioelcin): the extension puts the same wallets in your toolbar, this one is the self-hosted, all-chains view that runs on your own machine. Same idea, two shells — the dashboard is a DSH plugin and follows the DSH plugin conventions, so it keeps its own name.

dsh-crypto-portfolio README · dsh-crypto-portfolio：> Unofficial project, independently developed and maintained by community members.

dsh-crypto-portfolio README · 1 · My money lives in seven places, and checking the total means opening six pages：EVM assets in DeBank, SOL and staking on-chain, BTC in a block explorer, plus Binance / Bybit / Backpack / OKX / Bitget — each with its own app. Checking "how much do I actually have" meant hopping between six pages, and it was easy to miss a wallet along the way.

**This plugin puts all of it on a single screen.**

dsh-crypto-portfolio README · 2 · Assets that block explorers can't see：Some money is genuinely invisible: native Solana stake accounts (`getParsedStakeAccounts` misses them), Hyperliquid L1 staked HYPE and spot balances, exchange earn/funding accounts. None of these are plain SPL/ERC-20 tokens, so ordinary tools never read them.

**This plugin digs them out and prices them into your total** — including the 12.1 SOL staked in the account above and the ~318 HYPE staked on Hyperliquid.

text:
dsh-crypto-portfolio README · What it does：- **A zero-dependency web dashboard, launched from a real DSH plugin.** No framework, no CDN — Python stdlib + vanilla JS.
- **Covers BTC / EVM / Solana / Dogecoin / Cardano / Hyperliquid L1 / CEX.** DeBank's 73 chains, BTC P2SH+P2TR, native Solana staking, Dogecoin (BlockCypher), Cardano (Koios, incl. stake addresses), Hyperliquid's official API (staked HYPE + spot + perp equity + vault equity), and read-only CEX keys (named `<exchange>_read`). Five exchanges are supported (Binance, Bybit, Backpack, OKX, Bitget). Read-only CEX keys cover spot, OKX's funding sub-account and Backpack's futures collateral account, including tokenised equities; on Bitget the spot account is summed with the real futures accounts and the `S*` demo products are skipped, so play money never enters the total.
- **Global filters.** Category (BTC / EVM / Solana / Dogecoin / Cardano / CEX), wallet and chain dropdowns drive every panel — total, wallet-share pie, trend, chain distribution, token table.
- **Up to five block explorers per wallet.** Each wallet card ends in a row of explorer icons — the provider this app actually reads from comes first (DeBank · bitaps ·

dsh-crypto-portfolio README · How it integrates with DSH：Not a wrapper — a real plugin:

The dashboard also watches its own Python sources: editing `tracker/*.py` restarts
it within a couple of seconds (same process, no DSH restart), and static files are
read from disk on every request, so a UI change is a page reload. Settings → Service
has a *Restart the service* button for the cases where you want to force it.

dsh-crypto-portfolio README · How it integrates with DSH：- Declares a `dsh.bundle` manifest (`cordis.patch.yml`), so it installs with `dsh plugin add`.
- `apply(ctx)` hooks into the Cordis lifecycle: seeds user-local `profiles/default` from public templates on first run, spawns the dashboard as a child process, and stops it cleanly on `ctx.on('dispose')`.
- Exposes JSON APIs (`GET /api/refresh`, `/api/history`, `/api/tokens`, ...) that an agent can call directly, in addition to the web UI.

dsh-crypto-portfolio README · Privacy (important)：This repository contains **no private keys, no private wallets, no balances** — `tracker/config.py` ships with `WALLETS = []` and empty keys. All private configs live in git-ignored local `profiles/`. Clone it, review it, run it with confidence.

dsh-crypto-portfolio README · Requirements：- **`dsh` `0.1.1-rc.2`** (or a compatible release within the same pre-release line)
  and **Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`** — the range DSH itself declares.
- **Python 3.9+** with two pip packages:

```sh
  pip3 install requests pynacl
  ```

These are ordinary runtime dependencies, not vendored, so `pip` can pick the
  build that matches your platform.

dsh-crypto-portfolio README · From npm (recommended)：Installs prebuilt code and needs **no build permission**:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile demo add dsh-crypto-portfolio
dsh --profile demo
```

dsh-crypto-portfolio README · From a tarball (offline / air-gapped)：```sh
pnpm pack                                    # produces dsh-crypto-portfolio-0.1.0.tgz
dsh plugin --profile demo add ./dsh-crypto-portfolio-0.1.0.tgz
```

dsh-crypto-portfolio README · From GitHub：```sh
dsh plugin --profile demo add github:0xRabit/dsh-crypto-portfolio#<commit-sha>
```

This package is plain JavaScript + Python with **no build step**, so its
`prepare` is a no-op and pnpm does not need you to allowlist a build script —
unlike plugins that ship TypeScript sources. Pin a commit SHA anyway, so a
later push cannot change what runs on your machine.

dsh-crypto-portfolio README · Verify the layer before booting：```sh
dsh --profile demo --dump-config      # look for: # == dsh-crypto-portfolio
```

If that line is missing, the bundle did not activate — the package installed as a
plain dependency instead. Re-run the `add` and check the warning it printed.

dsh-crypto-portfolio README · Override the port：A patch replaces the whole `config` of a row, so restate every key you need.
Put this in `$DSH_HOME/profiles/demo/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: portfolio-tracker
  name: dsh-crypto-portfolio
  config:
    port: 8199

Or set `PORTFOLIO_PORT` in the environment.

dsh-crypto-portfolio README · Standalone (no DSH)：```sh
python3 run.py --init-template --port 8080   # seeds profiles/default from public templates
```

dsh-crypto-portfolio README · Layout：```
profiles/default/   sources.json + wallets.json (public template, auto-seeded)
templates/          public example configs (no secrets)
tracker/            backend fetchers (debank/btc/solana/hyperliquid/cex/prices)
static/             web dashboard (vanilla JS, no external deps)

dsh-crypto-portfolio README · Releasing：One command from the maintainer's working tree (the release scripts live there, not in
this published bundle), and the flow is deliberately split in two:

```sh
scripts/sync_public.sh --push                 # publish code — the version does NOT move
scripts/sync_public.sh --push --release       # bump + tag + refresh every market listing
```

dsh-crypto-portfolio README · Releasing：| Action | Version | Changelog | Tag | Market listings |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--push` | unchanged | unchanged | — | untouched |
| `--push --release` | bumped | `[Unreleased]` stamped | `vX.Y.Z` | branch pushed, PR prepared per market |

dsh-crypto-portfolio README · Releasing：- **A push is not a release.** Publishing code leaves `package.json` exactly as it is, so
  installed users see no update until a version is cut on purpose.
- **A release refreshes every listing.** The wording for each market lives here, under
  [`market/`](market/), so it is versioned with the code it describes and always matches
  the version being shipped. A market whose text did not change is skipped instead of
  getting an empty pull request.
